Preserve the complete original guarded source and finish custody for the merged cubic word bridge. This checkpoint publishes the whole 14,170,288-byte lossless archive (SHA256 45155cf75dcc9a46d4beeac3327c38810955f10e3c9bb5eade1d1ee17e990271), preserving the original 39,331,840-byte TAR and all 1,663 members. Source a193a1bbffbc5e535cf1e66d4b2a7a19d4708738 and immutable tag chained-transfer-whole-guarded-source-20261116-a193a1bbffbc were published with normal Git and exact ref readbacks. [pcc:unverified]

The original artifact policy selects four whole objects: source archive, full current PCC log, complete 8,959-key guard and published source ledger. Both PCC jobs hydrate their exact paths. Genuine artifact upload, whole remote replay, bot integration and current applicable checks are pending; initial source data must migrate before merge. No artifact-policy exception is requested. [pcc:unverified]

The checkpoint also preserves word PR #4415's actual merge c8aa3f9d, complete current CI96eb44 (both original proof gates27 audited/0 trusted; eight latest started checks successful, superseded cancellation retained), full byte guard89348c, and queue9f7e56. An unpublished failed/successful fetch capture reused a subject path: d8025d preserves the entire original claim/logs, separates immutable paths, restores original failure bytes, and appends an explicit correction without changing any prior ledger entry; both original subject checks now return unsigned/not-covered. All failed preflights and exact raw stderr remain. [pcc:unverified]

Validation: original current-parent ledger prefix/prose, scoped unchanged proof-workflow wiring, actionlint and cached checks pass. Broad historical benchrec1 and PCC exact-template wiring1 are preserved; the PCC diagnostic is byte-identical to the actual base. Original verifier, keyring, policy, native code, and directly pinned norm/word version01 source/reports/proof workflows are unchanged; no mathematical rerun was required. KB tools are unavailable (wrapper127); primary repository artifact/workflow/source records were reviewed, with no novelty inference. [pcc:unverified]

Queue: https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto/issues/3904 . Continue portable runtime source preparation and Consumer PR1587. Full scientific NEW28, seven Consumer metadata objects, actual checkpoint/ABI/Job/Pod/admission and the frozen full historical LP population remain distinct. Recorded exhausted budgets stop paid builds/jobs; locked autoresearcher/main-ledger fork constraints remain. [pcc:unverified]
